purpose: MiMo-V2.6-Flash (MOPD checkpoint) on TabbyAPI 2636ef60 + exllamav3 1.6.1: the post-out-scales-fix 2.52 bpw EXL3 pack, one 262,144-token slot with Q8 K/V, DFlash drafting (4-bit EXL3 drafter, 7 draft tokens), images on. Launched through scripts/lib/tabby_launch.py, which serves only the readiness and inference routes. Switch alias mimo26flash (owner direction 2026-10-12); qwen38fn stays the default. 1M does not fit beside 94 GiB of weights.

status.basis: Not yet servable: the switch refuses estimated profiles. Memory is estimated from the architecture (48 layers, 9 global-attention layers at 27,648 B/token FP16 K/V, 39 SWA-128 layers in fixed rings) and the pack size; the runtime builds and imports on GB10 (results/mimo-v26-flash-gates/runtimes-2026-10-12/RESULT.md). Plan B0 recorded NO_GO (readiness); the owner directed the integration on 2026-10-12 with fidelity measured and reported. Smoke (DIAGNOSTIC, results/mimo-v26-flash-gates/smoke-2026-10-13*): fidelity measured (dNLL 0.050 vs the release weights); the rerun's run peak was 104.76 GiB, but the kernel refused a GPU allocation while page cache crowded MemFree during the weight load, so the unit now bounds page cache (MemoryHigh 8G; the CUDA memory is not charged to it, anon is 3-4 GB). Qualification has not run.

safety.note: 8 GiB whole-host floor, the production precedent (qwen38fn). minimum_start_gib is a placeholder at the quiet host's ceiling until the smoke measures the peak; promotion sets it to ceil(peak + 8). CUDA allocations on GB10 are not charged to the memory cgroup, so MemoryHigh/MemoryMax bound only host-side pages (page cache of the 94 GiB pack read, the Python heap); the external memwatch floor is the binding control.

memory_model.basis: Estimate, replaced by the smoke measurement. K/V: exllamav3 caches only the 9 global-attention layers per token (4 K/V heads, head_dim 192, V padded to 192: 27,648 B/token FP16); at 8,8 that is 14,688 B/token with scales, 3.59 GiB at 262,144. The 39 SWA-128 layers and the drafter's 5 SWA-1024 layers keep fixed per-slot rings. overhead_gib: about 0.75 GiB of Q8 staging scratch plus about 4.75 GiB for the CUDA context, torch allocator slack, the vision tower and the TabbyAPI process.

qualification_options.note: vision_max_tokens: in chat mode MiMo answers MMMU with worked steps; at the bench's 256-token default 4 of 20 answers ran out of budget mid-calculation (finish_reason length; results/mimo-v26-flash-gates/preflight-2026-10-13/kit/vision). Thinking mode has no effort level here and would spend more.
